text: Dear Rohit, Kindly note that we need to release an advance of Rs 6,40,000 against invoice INV-88123 from Kalyani Forge Components for the Q2 die order. PO 4471 covers this. Please revert with the NEFT confirmation once processed. Best regards, Ananya

Dear Priya, Please process the Sundaram Freight settlement of Rs 32,00,000 for the September consignment note. The customs papers are attached for your approval. I have verified the freight ledger against PO 3312. Best regards, Ananya

Dear Rohit, The August payroll release to the employee pool stands at Rs 2,38,40,000. Kindly note the bank has already debited the escrow. Please revert if the NEFT batch number differs from the ledger. Best regards, Ananya

Dear Priya, For your approval: the GST reconciliation for Kalyani Forge and Sundaram is closed for August. I found a Rs 42,000 input credit mismatch on the freight leg. Please revert with the corrected credit note before EOD Friday. Best regards, Ananya

Dear Rohit, Kindly note Sundaram has levied a customs penalty of Rs 28,00,000 on the Chennai clearance. The amount is within the freight contract. Please process by NEFT today so the demurrage stops accruing. Please revert once done. Best regards, Ananya

Dear Priya, Please add Zenith Marine Supplies as an approved vendor for the Kochi yard order, value Rs 18,50,000. Their GST and PAN documents are on file with procurement. Kindly note this needs finance sign-off only. Best regards, Ananya

Dear Rohit, Kalyani Forge has requested the advance schedule be revised to Rs 9,50,000 per die set against PO 4471. The commercial terms are unchanged. Please revert with the payment calendar before the vendors meeting on Thursday. Best regards, Ananya

Dear Priya, Kindly note the statutory auditors need RTGS confirmations for all payments above Rs 50,00,000 made in the June quarter. Please revert with the bank statement extracts. For your approval, I have marked the relevant ledger pages. Best regards, Ananya

Hi Rohit — the board pack for the Kochi yard expansion is due Wednesday, and I want the working capital numbers in it to reflect the revised freight forecast, not the April baseline. Good stuff on the vendor consolidation, let's move fast on the remaining approvals and keep me posted on the treasury view. The capex committee only meets once this quarter, so we should land it there. Thanks, Vikram

Hi Priya — thanks for pulling the QBR deck together, the ops metrics section reads well and the vendor lead-time charts are exactly the story we want to tell the board this time. I'd like the same format kept for the October review, with the freight cost slide moved up front where the directors will actually look at it — keep me posted on the final numbers once Ananya's team signs off. Thanks, Vikram

Hi Priya — I'm opening the supplier summit on the 12th and I want to acknowledge the top vendors by name, especially the ones who held deliveries through the monsoon disruption — Sundaram and Kalyani Forge deserve the call-out, good stuff. Draft me two lines for each so the citations feel specific, and let's move fast on the invite list before the venue locks the seats. Thanks, Vikram

Hi Rohit — the Orion Metals term sheet landed and the offtake pricing is better than what we modelled in July, which is rare good news from that desk. I've asked legal to redline the exclusivity clause — the three-year lock-in is long for a commodity this volatile, and the board will ask about downside protection. Keep me posted on what finance thinks of the hedging leg. Thanks, Vikram

Hi Priya — for the anniversary note to all staff, I want to thank the yards and the finance team by name for the year we've had — nine years of Meridian and the best safety record in the group's history is not a small thing. Keep it warm, no corporate boilerplate. Let's move fast on the draft so comms has a week to translate it into Hindi and Tamil for the yard notice boards. Thanks, Vikram

Hi Priya — the ESG rating agency wants our emission disclosures a month earlier this cycle, and honestly it's good that they're pushing — the yard electrification numbers will read well against the FY24 baseline. Work with finance on the spend data and keep me posted on the timeline; the audit committee chair already asked about it, so we should not be late on this one. Thanks, Vikram

Hi Rohit — on the coastal freight tender, I'm inclined to let Ananya's team make the final call on the rate card since treasury owns the exposure — I don't want the CEO's office distorting a commercial negotiation, that never ends well. Keep me posted once the L1 is locked. Good stuff on the bid analysis, by the way, the landed-cost model was the clearest I've seen this year. Thanks, Vikram

Hi Priya — for the board dinner on the 15th, confirm the venue does a quiet private room — half the agenda is informal follow-ups from the capex discussion and that works better over dinner than in the boardroom. Let's move fast on the seating chart, keep the auditors at my table, and keep me posted once the menu is fixed. Thanks, Vikram

Dear Rohit, this is Ananya Rao. Kindly note Sundaram has levied a customs penalty of Rs 28,00,000 on the Chennai clearance. The amount is within the freight contract. Please process by NEFT today so the demurrage stops accruing. Please revert once done.
